اختطفا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَفَا (iḵtaṭafā) /ix.ta.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اُخْتُطِفَا (uḵtuṭifā) /ux.tu.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اِخْتَطِفَا (iḵtaṭifā) /ix.ta.tˤi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
